newsitem.title: CHINA: China says U.S. complicates ties over human rights.
newsitem.headline: China says U.S. complicates ties over human rights.

text.p: China said on Thursday that if the United States raised human rights as an issue it would complicate ties.

"If the human rights question is made into an issue to interfere in China's internal affairs, then this problem will become more and more complicated," a Foreign Ministry spokesman told a regular news briefing.
"The Chinese government cannot accept... using the human rights question to put pressure on the Chinese government or to interfere in China's internal affairs," the spokesman said.

He was asked for China's response after U.S. Secretary of State-designate Madeleine Albright said at her Senate confirmation hearing on Wednesday that the United States might co-sponsor a resolution criticising China's human rights record.
The resolution might be presented before the United Nations Human Rights Commission when it meets in Geneva early this year.
Albright said the U.S. focus would be "Chinese integration, not isolation."
